title: Read a bounded hosted response
responsibility: Reads response bytes while enforcing a maximum size even when Content-Length is missing.

inputs.name: hostedResponse.response
inputs.description: The HTTP response whose body should be consumed. A numeric Content-Length above the limit is refused before reading.

inputs.name: hostedResponse.limit
inputs.description: The maximum accepted byte count. Exactly that many bytes is allowed; the caller supplies the appropriate limit.

outputs.name: hostedResponse
outputs.description: A promise for all response bytes joined in order, or an empty array when no body exists. Cancels a read that fails or exceeds the limit and releases its reader lock.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects an oversized declared or actual body and propagates stream failures. The message names the byte limit during streaming.
